{"reason": "Failure rows show two demand-forecast-error patterns v1 misses: forecast-bias with bias 0.065-0.081 (below the 0.1 gate) and market-signal-mismatch alone. I lower the bias threshold to 0.06 and add a market-mismatch branch before else, converting those unknowns to demand-forecast-error, boosting recovery-rate while leaving correct supplier-delay calls untouched.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
